name: Sekrety poterjannyh dush
source:
Lost Souls' Secrets is a mysterious story about the fate of a young nurse who will try to uncover the secrets of a psychiatric hospital and learn more about her past...

An amazing adventure awaits you in the nineteenth century era, full of intrigue and unexpected plot twists!

[translated from [url=https://roxmoon.itch.io/lost-souls-secrets]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Lost Souls' Secrets》讲述一位年轻护士神秘莫测的命运。她将试着揭开精神病院的秘密，进一步了解自己的过去…

一场充满阴谋与意外转折的奇妙冒险，正在19世纪等待着你！

[译自[url=https://roxmoon.itch.io/lost-souls-secrets]itch.io[/url]]
